instruction: I'd like to enable the minimal view mode in VLC. This minimalist interface will give me more screen space for the video content and reduce visual clutter during playback.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling minimal view mode in VLC. Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric function to verify the qt-minimal-view setting is set to 1 in the VLC configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable minimal view mode in VLC
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from the appropriate location
Metric (check_qt_minimal_view) correctly parses config file and checks qt-minimal-view setting
Metric properly handles expected parameter - directly accesses rule['expected_qt_minimal_view'] without incorrect patterns like rule.get('type') or rule.get('rules')
Expected value 'qt-minimal-view=1' is semantically correct for enabling minimal view mode
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure configuration changes are persisted to file
Edge cases properly handled: missing config file (FileNotFoundError), missing setting (defaults to '0'), type conversion (int to str)
